reason: Nipple-like (mammillate or papillate) fits papillary, though a papilla is smaller than a nipple.
Pilose means long soft hairs. Glandular-pubescent says short soft hairs plus glands, so the hair type is lost.
Ribbon-shaped and strap-shaped both mean long, narrow and parallel-sided.
Nonglandular means not glandular.
Striate-nerved means many fine parallel veins, which is parallel venation.
Ecarinate means without a keel, which fits not keel-shaped.
Radially symmetric is the same as actinomorphic.
Globoid means globe-like, which is spherical. PATO lists globular as a synonym.
Not carinate means not keeled.
Voluble means twining, which is a kind of climbing.
Juxtaposed means side by side and close together, which fits approximate.
Long-lived means a long life span. It applies to a plant or a leaf.
The negation of saccate (pouch-shaped) is mapped to the FLOPO saccate class.
Not persistent means falling off, which is deciduous.
Moderate-sized is the same as medium-sized.
Plan-convex is a spelling variant of plano-convex.
Glanduliferous means bearing glands, so a gland is present.
Cancellate means latticed, which is a reticulate pattern.
Rimose means cracked or chinked, which is fissured.
Not crisped is the negation of crisped.
Soldered means fused, which is connate.
Non-lenticellate means no lenticels.
Fully developed is the opposite of undeveloped or immature. It is not the opposite of vestigial. Do not map it.
Obloid is the solid form of oblong.
Exauriculate means without auricles.
Bracteal means of or like a bract.
Not tailed means not caudate.
The word 'long' (length of the sheath) is lost when this is mapped to plain sheathing.
Binate means in pairs.
The PO lexicon lists pseudobulb as a synonym of corm. A botanist would say an orchid pseudobulb is not a corm, so the match is only fair.
Beadlike means moniliform.
Buried means subterranean only for organs that sit in soil. 'Seeds buried in pulp' would be wrong.
Opposite to leaves is the same as leaf-opposed.
Tuberlike means like a tuber, which is tuberous.
Vittate means bearing vittae, so a vitta is present.
Embracing means clasping the stem, as amplexicaul does.
Goniautoicous is a kind of autoicous. This only holds for the whole moss plant, since the constraint says autoicous is not an organ sex.
Pseudopaniculate means falsely panicle-like.
Stipeless means no stipe (stalk), so the stalk is absent.
Without keel is treated like ecarinate. A 'keel absent' form would be a more exact target, but this is consistent with R0606.
Barbellulate means minutely barbellate. The small size is lost, but it is the same character.
Arilless means without an aril.
Pea-like means a pea-type (papilionaceous) flower or a pea-like fruit. It does not mean that a keel is present.
Not gland-dotted is the negation of gland-dotted.
Broomlike means many slender erect twigs. That is close to virgate, but only for the plant, stems and branches.
Not crested is the negation of crested.
Not veined means no veins, and PO lists vein as a synonym of vascular bundle.
Cleistocarpous means a capsule that does not open, which is not dehiscent.
Untwisted means not twisted.
Not splitting usually describes a fruit that does not open, which is not dehiscent. PATO 'split' means clefted, which is a different meaning.
